data.modules_power: Total Watt peak power of your solar modules

learning.title: Self-learning efficiency factor
learning.description: Optional: compare the actual PV yield with the forecast every evening and learn the efficiency factor from clear days. Enable it in one entry only; it covers all entries of this integration.

data_description.learn_actual_entity: Energy sensor of today's total PV yield that resets every day (e.g. daily PV energy of the inverter).
data_description.learn_cloud_entity: Sensor with the average cloud cover of the day in %. Only days below the threshold are learned from.
data_description.learn_cloud_threshold: Days with less cloud cover than this count as clear.
data_description.learn_smoothing: Weight of a new clear day (0.2 = 20 % new, 80 % previous).
data_description.learn_min_days: Number of clear days needed before the learned factor is considered reliable.
data_description.learn_auto_apply: Once enough clear days are collected, the learned factor replaces the configured efficiency factor of all entries.
data_description.learn_sunset_offset: Minutes after sunset when the day is evaluated.

error.learn_actual_required: Please select the sensor with the actual daily PV yield.
error.learn_cloud_required: Please select a cloud cover sensor.
